world: A security team uses synthetic data to test whether an AI office assistant follows malicious instructions embedded in untrusted content. A test case has three attributes: delivery carrier (inbound email or retrieved document), persuasion pretext (time pressure or claimed authority), and probed behavior (create a local draft or attempt an external send). All tests use inert placeholders, a mock tool and no real recipients or private data. These are test-case categories, not instructions to carry out an attack. The generator proposes test cases; a separate harness checks whether the assistant respects the trust boundary.
